title: VALUES on the filtering side of a limited relationship has no blank row for unmatched values

source.quote: The additional blank row is never added to tables involved in a limited relationship
source.supports: no blank row on tables in a limited relationship

source.quote: blank virtual rows aren't added to compensate for referential integrity violations
an MMR relationship is always limited
source.supports: a many-to-many cardinality relationship is always limited

derivation: Product[Category] holds Clothing, Clothing, Accessories: 2 distinct values. Target has Footwear, which Product lacks, but the relationship is limited, so Product gets no blank row.
notes: With a regular relationship there would be a third row, BLANK.
